time-unit-converter.quickAnswer: Enter a duration, pick the unit you have and the one you want. The tool converts instantly — 1 hour is 3,600 seconds, a day is 86,400 seconds — and shows the exact rate used.
keyFacts: The second is the SI base unit of time, defined by 9,192,631,770 oscillations of a caesium-133 atom.
One minute is 60 seconds, one hour is 3,600 seconds, one day is 86,400 seconds.
Calendar months vary (28–31 days); this tool uses the average month of 30.44 days.
A year is taken as 365.25 days here, averaging in leap years.
howTo: Type the duration value into the value field.
Choose the source unit from the "From" dropdown.
Choose the target unit from the "To" dropdown.
Read the converted duration instantly; swap reverses the direction.
Check the rate line for the exact conversion factor.
time-unit-converter.formula:
result = value × (from-unit in seconds) ÷ (to-unit in seconds)
Example: minutes = hours × 3600 ÷ 60
time-unit-converter.workedExample:
Convert 2.5 hours to minutes.
Step 1: 2.5 hours in seconds = 2.5 × 3600 = 9000 s.
Step 2: 1 minute = 60 s.
Step 3: 9000 ÷ 60 = 150.
Answer: 2.5 hours = 150 minutes.

faqs.q: How many seconds are in an hour?
How many hours are in a week?
Why is a month 30.44 days here?
faqs.a: Calendar months have 28–31 days. 30.44 days is the average month length (365.25 ÷ 12), which keeps long-range conversions consistent.

faqs.q: How do I convert minutes to hours?
faqs.a: Divide minutes by 60. Example: 150 minutes ÷ 60 = 2.5 hours.

mistakes: A 'month' here is the 30.44-day average, not your calendar month — converting 1 month to days won't give you February's 28.
Same for years: 365.25 days averages in leap years. Don't use this for exact date arithmetic across a leap day.
Milliseconds vs seconds is a 1,000× cliff — typing 5000 into the seconds box when you meant ms turns 5 seconds into 83 minutes.
Weeks don't divide months evenly — '4 weeks = 1 month' is folk math. A month averages 4.345 weeks here.
Chaining conversions through rounded results drifts — convert straight from the original value instead of converting the converted.
